**Risk flags:**
- Defendant in 1 case(s), total claims RM106,900  
- Negative equity in latest year  
- Single shareholder holds 50.59%  

**Overview:**  
Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. operates a coffee shop and café in Penang, while its registered office is in Kuala Lumpur. The private limited company was incorporated on 28 August 1995 and was formerly known as Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd. until a name change on 27 November 2025. The top shareholder owns 50.59% of the equity, and the company reports negative equity of RM‑18,522 in the most recent financial snapshot. The firm has five directors and a paid‑up share capital of RM500,000.
